description: Find state legislators. Filter by jurisdiction, name, chamber (upper/lower), party, or district. Returns name, current/prior roles, party, contact details, OpenStates IDs.

per_page.description: 1-20 (default 20) — OpenStates rejects anything above 20 with a 400; a higher value is clamped to 20 and the response says so. Use `page` for more results.

name: search_legislators
